summary.name: Constructivism. This is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicitly, it uses forceful diagonals, wedges, circles, rectangular blocks, photographic cutouts, and bold typography. Red, black, and cream form a restricted high-contrast palette. Motion uses directional entrances, cuts, and recomposition while keeping a clear headline and focal point.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly, the source says Constructivism alone works for headline posters and calls to action. Inferred from its visual cues: campaign posters, editorial openers, and motion posters with staged geometric compositions. Target topic and audience are unspecified in the source.
summary.limitations: Explicitly, the palette is restricted to red, black, and cream. Full-color source photographs are to be avoided. Hybrids are advised when photos need tonal rendering or headlines must drive diagonal motion. Avoid rotated body copy, soft easing or bounce, and multiple competing headlines.
summary.palette: Suggested, not approved: background #F4ECD8 (cream), foreground #171717 (ink), accent_1 #C72C2C (construction red). Use only when no task, brand, or reference palette is supplied; supplied colors override these. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 15.227:1. Accent_1 with background measures 4.663:1, meeting the 4.5 normal-text target in two-color checks only. Verify composited frames. Do not recolor assets or add hues.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicitly, motion uses directional entrances, hard cuts, and recomposition along one dominant diagonal per scene, with the headline kept as focal point. Video is keyframed from composition time and needs no live input. Interactive delivery may use scroll-driven diagonal entries that stack on narrow screens and go static under reduced motion. Avoid soft easing and bounce. Deliberate sharp cuts are preferred.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source for this style. The shared audio guidance sets no fixed genre, tempo, voice, or mandatory layer. Inferred: a restrained, sharp accent could align with hard cuts, and any narration must stay intelligible. Honor user-supplied audio. Source or create only authorized assets, then verify balance, clipping, and picture sync.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicitly, the style combines transparent photographic cutouts, diagonal SVG masks, and real live text. Halftone cutouts, if used, print in #171717 on #F4ECD8. Kinetic headlines call for a heavy condensed sans. Fonts and assets must be loaded before rendering. Topic-specific copy, photographs, and fonts are unspecified and must be supplied or authorized.
summary.combinations: Style-050 (halftone tone rendering in ink) suits campaign posters and editorial openers. Keep dot angle fixed, use red only as flat wedge fields, and avoid moire and halftone over text. Style-093 (diagonal kinetic typography) suits slogans and short social spots. Red highlights one word, and body copy is not rotated. Motion patterns 007, 012, and 015 are optional and need scene-level support. Choosing none is valid.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the primary pipeline for timing, sync, validation, and export. Remotion is fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and that reason must be recorded. HTML/CSS and SVG render visuals, GSAP drives motion through a paused timeline, and chroma.js only validates colors and contrast. Verify opening, action, transition, and closing frames, plus full playback, dimensions, frame rate, sync, and loop continuity. Deliver source, contact sheet, parameters, and render instructions, stating missing assets.
